entries.text: The most powerful CEOs in tech and finance keep saying the same word.
They have watched twelve trillion dollars and they keep repeating one word. Tokens.
Best-thinking-model AI cost sixty dollars in twenty twenty three. Now it costs ten cents.
Stablecoins already move thirty three trillion dollars. More than Visa and Mastercard combined.
Now the same job is beginning for stocks, bonds, and ETFs. This is moving faster than most people realize.
